Admin.// ResetPasswordOnStartup: One boot only: re-hashes Password onto an existing admin account. Leave false in normal operation.

// EmailSettings: Self-hosted mailcow, TWO sending identities. Username/Password are supplied from Infisical as EmailSettings__Username / EmailSettings__Password and must never be committed. Password is a mailbox APP PASSWORD scoped to SMTP, not the mailbox login password. Host is mail.buildbykashyap.in even though the addresses are @inksphere.space: one mailcow box serves both domains and mail.inksphere.space has no A record. Port 587 (STARTTLS) - 465 is open but System.Net.Mail.SmtpClient cannot speak implicit TLS and will hang.

EmailSettings.// Transactional: noreply@ - verification, sign-in and reset codes, invitations, meeting guest codes. Nobody reads replies.
EmailSettings.// Product: taskflow@ - the thank-you after verification. Replies reach a real mailbox. Username/Password may be omitted to reuse the pair above, which requires mailcow 'Allow to send as' on the noreply mailbox.
